instruction: I have a PowerPoint presentation 'lecture1-2021-with-ink.pptx' on the desktop with speaker notes. Clear all notes from every slide in this presentation - remove all text from the notes section of all slides.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires clearing all notes from all 7 slides. Verified by checking that all note text frames are empty.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly extracts notes text from all slides in the presentation
Metric appropriately checks that all notes are empty (no content after stripping whitespace)
Complete coverage: evaluator verifies ALL slides' notes, matching the instruction requirement 'from every slide'
